prompt: How many player entries were in the event that the winner of the 2008 Aussie Millions also won in 2010 at the PokerStars World Championship of Online Poker?
answer: The 2010 PokerStars WCOOP Main Event had **2,443 player entries**. (Its winner was Tyson “POTTERPOKER” Marks; the 2008 Aussie Millions winner was Alexander Kostritsyn.)
